findings: F1 HIGH Gallery.tsx:540/551/578 — no cancelled branch in CardImpl; retry() only reachable from error branch. Paid video job keeps jobId per INVARIANT but user cannot reach it -> must regenerate -> pays twice. Violates contract at types.ts:15.

passedAC: AC1 jobId=null 10 sites audited none abort-triggerable
AC3 no AbortController state in storage
tasks.reAuditResult: F1+F5 closed. Money chain verified end-to-end: finalizeCancelled keeps jobId -> catch-return skips removePendingJob -> ledger intact -> card shows ทำต่อ -> retry() preserves jobId -> requestVideo resumed=true skips POST /videos entirely. ผู้ใช้ต้องรู้ว่าดาวเป็นของกลุ่ม ไม่ใช่ใบเดียว — toast ครั้งแรกที่ toggle โดนหลายใบ (ข้อความบอกจำนวนจริง) หรือ affordance อื่นที่ชัดกว่า
ของเดิมที่ผู้ใช้เก็บไว้ใน localStorage รูปแบบเก่าต้องไม่พังตอนเปลี่ยนรูปแบบคีย์ (migrate หรือ ignore อย่างสงบ ไม่ throw)

tasks.result: favoriteKeyOf v2: FNV-1a twin-hash (Math.imul, sync-safe for render path) + prompt LENGTH + 24-char prefix, three fixed-size collision layers. Separator U+001F (cannot be typed into a prompt). Measured quota: 5.81MB/11.53MB -> 0.36MB flat regardless of prompt length. 200k distinct prompts = 0 collisions. prune waits on galleryRehydrated promise so it never runs against an empty gallery; with F2 on it prunes by real gallery contents, with F2 off it falls back to a 30-day TTL via atelier_favorite_stamps. status normalized to d/x in the key (not per-status, or a key would change mid-flight as loading->done and drop the star), and restore moved to restoreFavoriteOnSettle in runRequest.
tasks.ac34Decision: AC3 vs AC4 resolved without choosing: the user CAN still star a cancelled card and it stays starred in that session (survives resetModeGallery per their intent), but it is never written to localStorage — a card with no real output has nothing worth persisting, and persisting it was the root of P2. Side benefit: creates no new orphan keys.
tasks.migration: v2 prefix on every key; loadFavorites keeps only v2-prefixed entries and drops v1 silently. Chose drop over migrate because v1 embedded the raw prompt separated by spaces so it cannot be split back reliably — a wrong re-hash puts stars on the WRONG image, worse than losing them. v1 only ever existed on this unreleased branch (T13, same sprint), so the real user base is zero.

Fixed with slice before writing back to cache.
